title: RequestApprovalPayload
description: Payload for the REQUEST_APPROVAL intent. Solicits approval from one or more authorized approvers for a privileged action.

request_id.description: Identifier of the upstream action being approved (e.g. 'pr-2026-001').

approvers_required.description: Agents/principals whose approval is needed to authorize the action. Order is not significant.

approvers_received.description: Subset of approvers_required who have already granted approval. Useful for partial-chain visibility.

details.description: Human-readable description of the action and its context. Approvers read this to decide.

amount.description: Optional dollar value of the action being approved. Required for purchase/payment action_types.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Required if amount is set.

expires_at.description: Hard deadline for approval. After this, the request is treated as denied.

linked_security_event_id.description: If approval is for a security-driven action, reference the originating SECURITY_EVENT.

rationale.description: Optional justification paragraph from the requester.

allOf.description: Purchase or payment approvals must include amount and currency.

examples.details: Vendor: Acme Tools Inc; Amount: 6000 USD; Purpose: Hardware for office expansion
